user.title: Comfee dishwasher
user.description: Choose cloud discovery or enter the local LAN credentials manually.

cloud.title: MSmartHome account
cloud.description: The account is used only during setup to obtain the local device key. It is not saved in the config entry.

manual.title: Local dishwasher credentials
manual.description: Use hexadecimal token and key values obtained from MSmartHome.

error.device_not_found: No E1 dishwasher was found on the local network.
error.device_not_in_account: The discovered dishwasher is not present in this MSmartHome account.
error.device_auth_failed: The device was found, but no local key could authenticate it.
error.invalid_token: Token and key must be non-empty hexadecimal values.
error.manual_auth_failed: The local credentials did not authenticate the dishwasher.
error.setup_failed: The dishwasher setup failed. Check the account, network and device state.
